title: Bank alerts to a day-book, with a local Gemma
why_read: A real-world small-business automation story using a local AI model to parse bank notification emails into a ledger, interesting as a practical use case but modest in technical depth.
analysis: The author built a tool that takes pasted bank alert emails from a Nigerian POS cash agent and uses a locally-run Gemma language model to extract structured transaction data into a simple daily ledger. This is a nice example of applying a small local LLM to a concrete, low-resource use case instead of using cloud APIs, which matters for privacy and offline use in regions with unreliable connectivity. The technical content is fairly light, mostly product-building narrative rather than deep model or engineering insight.
